commercial_impact.risk_summary: CRITICAL TOXICOSIS HAZARD: High Aflatoxin B1 (28.4 ppb) combined with high moisture (13.8%) creates active fungal proliferation risk in bulk silo. Will cause immunosuppression, poor FCR, and liver lesions in broilers if compounded into pre-starter or starter diets.
commercial_impact.recommended_action: REJECT ENTIRE CONSIGNMENT (42.5 MT). Do not allow weighbridge discharge. If diverted to commercial layer feed or older birds, mandatory binder dosage of 2.5 kg/MT hydrated sodium calcium aluminosilicate (HSCAS) + organic acid mold inhibitor required with written GM approval.
